release_notes:
Backfill missing translation labels so non-English UIs no longer show blanks

Newer features added ~160+ label variables to the English language files that were
never backfilled to the other languages, so those labels rendered blank in every
non-English language (admin and client). Filled every missing $BE_*/$CUST_* variable
across all admin (admincp/languages) and client (languages) files with the English
value as a graceful fallback — 3,186 admin + 1,278 client labels — so the UI shows
readable text everywhere instead of blanks. Existing translations are untouched; the
backfilled entries are English placeholders that can be professionally translated later.
